Join our telehealth platform ‘Intellect’ as a Nutritionist/Dietician, where you will provide personalised nutrition consultations tailored to our clients’ needs and goals. These consultations are conducted primarily through scheduled 30-minute video sessions on our platform.

We’re seeking to partner with registered dietitians and nutritionists to build a community dedicated to bringing a holistic approach to both mental and physical health to the public.

This is a freelance remote role with the flexibility to decide your business hours. Local candidates are preferred but others can still be considered. This role is a great opportunity to supplement your current job or private practice.

Responsibilities:

  • Utilise video and text-based platforms to offer individualised nutritional counselling to clients, taking into account their dietary preferences, health goals, and specific requirements.
  • Create insightful, relevant, content and engaging videos that effectively communicate nutritional concepts, practical tips, and the latest industry trends.
  • Conceptualize and design innovative nutrition programs that cater to varying client needs, incorporating feedback and staying aligned with company objectives.
  • Foster meaningful and productive relationships with clients by delivering clear and empathetic communication, addressing their questions and concerns, and providing ongoing support throughout their nutritional journey.
  • Keep up-to-date with the latest nutritional research, guidelines, and trends to ensure the information shared is evidence-based, accurate, and aligns with industry best practices.

Requirements

  • 4 years of relevant work experience as a Nutritionist/Dietician
  • Master's degree in Clinical Nutrition or a related field.
  • Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) or equivalent certification.
  • Experience delivering virtual nutrition guidance.
  • Strong communication skills for effective client interaction.
  • Proficient in creating engaging nutritional content.
  • Empathetic and client-focused approach to counselling.
  • Familiarity with nutrition software and virtual communication tools.
  • Affiliated with your country’s local nutrition/dietitian associations is a good to have

Benefits

This is a freelance remote role with the flexibility to decide your business hours.

This role is a great opportunity to supplement your current job or private practice.

This flexible, freelance role allows you to set your own hours, making it an excellent way to supplement your current job or private practice. While we prefer local candidates, we welcome applications from skilled professionals who are committed to expanding access to quality nutritional care.

Why Work With Us?

As part of our community, you’ll collaborate with other nutrition and wellness experts to make a real impact in people’s lives. You’ll have the creative freedom to design innovative programs, create engaging content, and foster meaningful client relationships.

  • Build trusting client relationships by offering empathetic, clear guidance, addressing questions and concerns, and providing ongoing support throughout their journey
  • Stay current with the latest in nutritional science, research, and trends, ensuring that the advice and information shared is evidence-based and up-to-date

Requirements

  • Experience: Proven experience as a Nutritionist or Dietitian in a professional setting
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nutrition or a related field
  • Certification: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) or equivalent recognized certification
  • Skills: Strong communication abilities, with the capacity to simplify complex concepts and engage clients effectively
  • Content Creation: Proficiency in creating compelling educational content, from written materials to video resources
  • Approach: Empathetic, client-focused approach to counseling, with a passion for helping clients achieve their goals
  • Tech-Savvy: Familiarity with nutrition software, virtual communication tools, and a comfortable grasp of digital platforms

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Medical, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

This position is a contract role with Mochi Medical, a physician-owned professional corporation affiliated with Mochi Health Corp. Mochi Health is a management service organization that supports Mochi Medical by providing administrative and operational services, but the role and clinical practice are with Mochi Medical.

Employment for this position will be with Mochi Medical, a physician-owned professional corporation affiliated with Mochi Health, Corp. Mochi Health supports Mochi Medical by providing administrative and operational services, but the role and clinical practice are under Mochi Medical.

Capitated ModelContract / Remote (US-Only)

About The Role

Mochi Medical, originally founded as an obesity management practice, is expanding its virtual care model beyond weight management. We’re looking for Registered Dietitian & Nutritionists who are committed to delivering high-quality, accessible, and affordable care across a growing range of specialties. While obesity and metabolic health remain core areas of focus, our providers also support patients in areas such as dermatology, hormone replacement therapy, depression & anxiety, longevity, and hair loss. You will play a crucial role in guiding individuals through their health journey and provide personalized, evidence-based nutritional support. This role is ideal for someone passionate about metabolic health, behavioral change, and leveraging digital healthcare to improve patient outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct one-on-one virtual consultations to discuss nutrition, obesity medicine, and personalized meal planning.
  • Provide nutritional counseling that supports patients across multiple specialty areas (ex. dermatology, hormone health, mental wellness, longevity, hair loss, etc.) and recognizing the critical link between nutrition and whole-body health.
  • Build rapport, credibility, and engagement with members through exceptional communication.
  • Use motivational interviewing techniques to guide members toward sustainable lifestyle changes.
  • Provide guidance on lifestyle choices tailored to metabolic health, performance, and longevity goals.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest research on obesity medicine, binge eating disorder, and the nutritional dimensions of emerging specialty areas (e.g., gut-skin axis, hormonal balance, mood and diet).
  • Collaborate with our team of innovative healthcare providers to ensure holistic patient care.
  • Adapt to a fast-paced startup environment and contribute to team-wide improvements.
  • Engage in educational content creation (blog writing, social media, program development) as needed.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Licensed Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) with at least 1 year of experience.
  • Currently possess at least 1 state license.
  • Experienced in obesity medicine, binge eating disorder, and nutrition-based approaches to chronic and lifestyle-related conditions.
  • Proficient in online scheduling tools, EMR systems, and video-visit coordination.
  • Skilled in motivational interviewing and patient education.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, evolving startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience providing Medical Nutritional Therapy (MNT).
  • Willingness to obtain additional licenses.
  • Experience or interest in nutrition as it relates to one or more of the following: dermatology, hormone replacement therapy, mental health (depression & anxiety), longevity, or hair loss.
  • Active RDN licensure in one or more of the following priority states: Nevada, Maine, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, District of Columbia, Wyoming, Alaska, South Dakota, or Vermont.
  • Licensure in Connecticut, Kansas, Delaware, Wisconsin, Tennessee, Mississippi, or New Mexico is also a strong plus. We still encourage all qualified RDNs to apply regardless of state licensure.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Mission with impact: Join a nationwide team bringing dietitian care to patients who have rarely had access to it, and see your work show up in their outcomes.
  • Flexibility that is actually flexible: 100% remote. Set your own hours and your own breaks.
  • Technology that empowers: One platform for scheduling, video visits, and charting, with AI charting assistance.
  • Clinical support behind you: Direct access to our Medical Directors, plus a clinical support library of patient handouts and our nutrition protocol.
  • Collaborative community: A supportive network of RDs who share your passion for helping people live better through food, and who trade cases, resources, and wins.
  • Nutre meal discounts: A discount on Nutre’s chef-prepared meals.

Compensation

  • Job Type: 1099 contractor
  • Pay: Up to $60 per hour, with additional earning opportunities

Interested? Submit your resume as a PDF.

Equal Opportunity

Mochi Medical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

Mochi Medical complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at .

About the Role

Black Girl Vitamins is looking for an engaging, culturally aligned Registered Dietitian (RD) or Certified Nutritionist (CN) to serve as an educational face for our community and provide direct support to our customers. In this dual-role, you will build trust through 1-on-1 micro-consultations, weekly public live-streaming and customer webinars —translating nutritional science around Black health disparities, vitamin deficiencies, and holistic wellness into accessible, relatable guidance.

Key Responsibilities

  • 1-on-1 Virtual Consultations:

    • Provide complimentary 15-minute 1-on-1 virtual consultation sessions to Black Girl Vitamins customers.

    • Maintain daily scheduling availability (approx. 2–3 dedicated hours per day via a provided Google Calendar/Scheduling link) to review customer goals, answer supplement questions, and offer tailored wellness advice.

  • Additional

    • Educational Programming: Host 1 interactive monthly or bi-weekly educational webinar for customers covering key wellness topics (e.g., Vitamin D deficiency, gut health, hormonal balance, reproductive health).

    • Live Social Content: Host 1 weekly TikTok Live session (~30–45 minutes) answering live audience questions, busting wellness myths, and explaining supplement science in an entertaining, digestible format.

    • Content Preparation & Strategy: Outline weekly discussion topics, Q&As, and slide decks or key takeaways for community events in collaboration with the marketing team.

    • Brand Advocacy: Serve as an expert voice to ensure messaging aligns with evidence-based nutritional standards while remaining relatable and culturally nuanced.

Qualifications

  • Credentials: Registered Dietitian (RD / RDN) or Certified Nutritionist (MS/PhD in Clinical Nutrition or relevant state licensure).

  • On-Camera & Counseling Presence: Strong experience hosting live streams/short-form video alongside proven experience conducting 1-on-1 client assessments or counseling.

  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable managing calendar availability and client bookings through Google Calendar / Google Scheduling.

  • Communication Style: Ability to break down complex medical/clinical data into engaging, everyday language tailored to Black women's health needs in both public and 1-on-1 settings.

  • Product Knowledge: Familiarity with dietary supplements, micronutrient bioavailability, and general wellness practices.

Compensation & Pay Structure

With the added scope of daily 1-on-1 consultations (~10–15 hours/week for client sessions + ~3–5 hours/week for group webinars, live streams, and preparation), contract rates reflect a total commitment of 15–20 hours per week.

  • 1-on-1 Consultations (10–15 hrs/week): $45 – $60 per hour.

  • TikTok Live Sessions (30–45 mins + prep): $150 – $250 per session.

  • Customer Webinars (60 mins + slide preparation): $250 – $400 per webinar.

Full-Time | Fully Remote | Some Evening and Weekend Working Required | Fixed-Term Contract

We're looking for an HCPC-registered Dietitian or AfN-registered Nutritionist to join our growing clinical team at one of the UK's most exciting health-tech companies.

In this role, you'll support people living with obesity to make sustainable lifestyle and behaviour changes, working as part of a multidisciplinary team within our Specialist Weight Management Service (SWMS).

This is a fully remote role: all delivery is via video consultation and in-app messaging, and you can be based anywhere in the UK. Flexibility is required to support some early evenings and Saturdays as and when needed to support our NHS contracts.

The Challenge

More than 1 in 4 adults in the UK are living with obesity; a chronic condition that often negatively impacts their physical and mental health, and therefore quality of life. Access to specialist weight management services for the treatment of obesity remains limited and varies geographically due to a lack of funding. Existing services face long waiting lists, resulting in treatment delays which can adversely affect patient outcomes.

Enter Second Nature...

By bringing together the latest behavioural science, psychology, technology, and the talents of our incredible team, our mission is to eradicate obesity and type 2 diabetes for all, and as part of that mission, we are aiming to increase access to effective treatment for people living with obesity. Second Nature provides specialist weight management services to support people living with obesity.

About us:

  • We've positively changed the lives of 300,000+ people through accessible, evidence-based healthcare.
  • We're rated 'Excellent' on Trustpilot by over 8,000 of our members.
  • We're the UK’s largest digital health provider to the NHS
  • We're a leading B2C provider of GLP-1 medication-assisted weight loss programmes, and 1 of 5 NICE-approved providers to deliver these services within the NHS in the future
  • Our team members stay with us for an average of 4.3 years

The Role

We're looking for a dynamic Health Coach who is passionate about making a positive difference to those living with obesity to grow our current clinical team. You will be part of an innovative Specialist Weight Management Service (SWMS) that uses a multi-disciplinary team (MDT) approach to obesity treatment and technology to optimise patient engagement and outcomes. Our MDT includes doctors, dietitians, psychologists and physical activity specialists, all with special interests in obesity.

You will provide nutritional and lifestyle interventions to people living with obesity to support them to make sustainable dietary and behaviour changes, in collaboration with the MDT. You'll be using evidence-based health coaching techniques, such as motivational interviewing, goal setting and behaviour change frameworks. Whilst it is important to be able to work autonomously, you will receive comprehensive training. You will also have access to clinical supervision and support from senior clinicians.

This post is full-time (40 hours/week) and fixed-term, with flexible hours and a view to extend based on the needs of the service. You'll work fully remotely, connecting with service users through video consultations and in-app messaging. The role requires working some early evenings per week and Saturdays as and when needed to support our NHS contracts.

What you'll do:

  • Independently implement appropriate initial assessment methods to allocate service users to the most suitable treatment pathway
  • Deliver group-based and one-to-one nutritional and lifestyle interventions remotely via video calls, to support changes in dietary and physical activity behaviours
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support between sessions through in-app messaging
  • Support service users across both medicated and non-medicated programmes, including those accessing GLP-1 medication
  • Attend regular MDT meetings to monitor the care of our service users
  • Attend clinical supervision to discuss complex or high-risk cases
  • Appropriately manage clinical risk (e.g. safeguarding concerns) when it arises during clinical practice
  • Maintain adequate CPD, receive regular clinical supervision in accordance with good practice guidelines and continue to meet your registration requirements (HCPC or AfN)
  • Maintain confidentiality of information in line with the requirements of the Data Protection Act and ensuring that participant confidentiality is protected at all times
  • Contribute to innovation projects, service evaluation, and ongoing programme development at Second Nature

Requirements

You have experience working in a weight management/bariatric/eating disorder setting

  • A qualified HCPC-registered Dietitian or AfN-registered Nutritionist with experience of weight management and/or bariatric experience, or working with patients in an eating disorder setting
  • Proven experience delivering group-based programmes, with the confidence to facilitate sessions effectively in a digital setting
  • A solid understanding of obesity as a condition and the issues many people living with obesity face, including weight stigma
  • Experience or training in health coaching, behaviour change, or motivational interviewing, with awareness of coaching models and approaches
  • Able to provide supportive, empathetic patient-centred care to patients who may have complex physical and mental health needs

You're comfortable working fully remotely

  • You enjoy remote working and can stay motivated and organised without an office around you
  • You have a suitable home working setup, including a private space for confidential consultations and a reliable internet connection

You can work autonomously and collaboratively with a doctor-led multidisciplinary team (MDT) to oversee patient care

  • You'll confidently and independently manage a caseload of service users, delivering nutritional and lifestyle interventions via video calls and in-app messaging, and working collaboratively with our MDT

You have experience in supporting the coordination of a healthcare service

  • You have experience in monitoring and supporting patients' journeys through a service in line with an organisation's protocols, including scheduling assessments and appointments, monitoring attendance rates and following up with patients, writing GP letters, and revising protocols
  • You have experience using Excel or Google Sheets (or other similar programmes) to monitor patients' journeys

You are dynamic and have a strong drive to work in healthcare tech

  • You have experience thriving in fast-paced environments and are energised by the dynamic nature of start-up life, where being hands-on and adaptable to the evolving needs of the service is essential
  • You're confident in using technology to provide patient care, including recording and reviewing patient notes, and providing in-app coaching
  • Excited by digital initiatives that increase access to healthcare

Education/Qualifications:

  • HCPC registration as a Dietitian, or AfN registration as a Nutritionist (Registered Nutritionist or Registered Associate Nutritionist)
  • Relevant degree in Dietetics, Nutrition or a related field

To apply

Please submit your CV and cover letter via this application page, and include your HCPC or AfN registration number. Unfortunately, we're unable to progress applications without appropriate registration. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to respond to everyone individually. If we don't have a chance to get back to you, we're not intentionally being rude, but please assume it's a no for now!

  • Work from home with flexible hours
  • Joining a culture of intelligent, friendly, and highly-motivated individuals who are passionate about what they do
  • A competitive market salary
  • 25 days of holiday plus national holidays

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the team:

The B2B team operates like a startup within CookUnity — entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and bold in its ambitions. We're building a new category at the intersection of food, healthcare, and outcomes-driven nutrition. Our Healthcare vertical is one of our highest-priority growth areas, and this role sits right at the center of it.

CookUnity is the leading chef-to-consumer platform connecting independent chefs with food lovers across the country. By combining culinary creativity with a powerful technology platform, we're redefining meal delivery and making chef-crafted meals more accessible than ever. Our mission is to empower chefs while delivering an exceptional food experience to customers nationwide.

About the Role:

CookUnity is building a clinical nutrition model to support the delivery of medically tailored meals (MTM) for members living with chronic conditions — primarily diabetes, cancer, weight management with GLP-1s, and cardiovascular disease. We work with a network of Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs), including 1099 contractors and subcontracted providers, to deliver nutrition assessments and nutrition education and counseling to members across diverse, medically complex populations.

The RD Supervisor will be the clinical anchor of this model. This is a part-time, fully remote role (~20 hours/week) for a seasoned RDN who brings deep clinical expertise, a passion for population health and food equity, and the judgment to translate evidence-based practice into scalable, culturally responsive care. You will work directly with CookUnity leadership and our two founding RDNs to co-develop the clinical framework, carry a focused direct-care caseload, and ensure every clinician in our network delivers consistent, high-quality care.

What You'll Do

This role ramps in three phases, though phases may overlap depending on contract timelines. The primary focus in the first 90 days is building the clinical model; direct patient care may begin concurrently if active contracts require it. Network supervision scales as the model and tools are in place.

Phase 1 — First 90 Days: Clinical Model Development (Primary Focus)

  • Develop a framework for building and growing the CookUnity RDN network — defining the clinical competencies, disease-area specializations, and cultural and linguistic attributes required of network providers, and establishing a structured recruitment and vetting process to ensure every RDN added to the network is aligned with the CookUnity model of care.
  • Co-develop disease-specific nutrition protocols for diabetes, oncology, weight management with GLP-1s, and cardiovascular conditions grounded in current evidence and clinical guidelines (ADA Standards of Care, ASCO, ACC/AHA, Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics Evidence-Based Practice Guidelines)
  • Define the nutrition assessment framework — intake tools, flagging criteria, and escalation pathways for medically complex members
  • Build structured visit frameworks for nutrition education and counseling (initial assessments, follow-up, and group modalities as applicable)
  • Integrate behavior change methodology — including Motivational Interviewing, Stages of Change, and SMART goal-setting — into care delivery standards
  • Establish culturally responsive practice standards to support care delivery across diverse patient communities
  • Develop clinical documentation standards, quality metrics, and outcome tracking aligned with plan and regulatory requirements
  • Build and curate a clinical resource library — including condition-specific patient education materials, counseling tools, and handouts — building on the existing nutrition assessment and education templates; the resource library will be the foundation for training and standardizing care delivery across the RDN network

Phase 2 — Direct Patient Care (May Begin Concurrently with Phase 1)

  • Carry a defined direct-care caseload (target: 8–12 active members) spanning diabetes, cancer, weight management with GLP-1s, and cardiovascular conditions
  • Conduct comprehensive nutrition assessments and develop individualized, person-centered care plans that incorporate medically tailored meal planning
  • Deliver evidence-based nutrition counseling and education using behavior change frameworks
  • Collaborate with health plan care teams and care coordinators on member care management and referral pathways

Phase 3 — Ongoing: RDN Network Supervision (As Model Matures)

  • Provide clinical oversight and quality assurance for the CookUnity RDN network; scope of supervision calibrated appropriately for 1099 contractors (clinical quality and protocol fidelity) versus subcontracted providers
  • Conduct regular chart audits and clinical case reviews to assess documentation quality, protocol adherence, and clinical appropriateness
  • Facilitate monthly peer review or case consultation sessions with the RDN network
  • Serve as the primary clinical escalation point for complex, high-acuity, or ethically sensitive cases
  • Lead onboarding and training of contracted and subcontracted RDNs to the CookUnity clinical model — including use of the standardized nutrition assessment, the nutrition education template, and the clinical resource library — to ensure consistent, model-faithful care delivery across the network
  • Identify individual and collective training needs; coordinate continuing education or skill-building resources for the network

Required Qualifications

  • Active Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential in good standing with the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR)
  • Active state dietitian licensure where required by state of practice (e.g., CDN in New York)
  • 5+ years of clinical RD experience with a meaningful focus on chronic disease management — diabetes, cardiovascular disease, oncology, weight management, or combinations thereof
  • Demonstrated experience delivering Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and nutrition counseling to vulnerable, medically complex, and/or diverse patient populations
  • Familiarity with behavior change frameworks, including Motivational Interviewing
  • Strong clinical documentation skills and comfort with telehealth or virtual care delivery
  • Self-directed and comfortable building processes in a fast-moving, start-up environment

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications

  • CDCES — Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (strongly preferred; required for certain plan contracts)
  • NBC-HWC — National Board Certified Health and Wellness Coach
  • CSO — Board Certified Specialist in Oncology Nutrition
  • CSOWM — Board Certified Specialist in Obesity and Weight Management (particularly relevant given GLP-1 meal line)
  • Washington State Licensed Dietitian (LD) licensure, or willingness to obtain (preferred for current contract pipeline; licensure support available)
  • FAND — Fellow of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics
  • Formal Motivational Interviewing training or certification (MINT network or equivalent)
  • Experience in medically tailored meal (MTM), food-as-medicine, or community-based nutrition programs
  • Prior experience supervising or mentoring RDNs, dietetic interns, or clinical nutrition staff
